about: PEPPER'S CORNER STORE (f1_corner_store) review views. Venue frame: world x = 957 - X, z = 84 + D, y = 14.1 + Y (X across the frontage, D into the building, Y up from the floor). Make: lune run tools/bake/main.luau; lune run tools/bake/editor_ground.luau; lune run tools/bake/backdrop.luau; lune run tools/bake/corner_store.luau; lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/review/corner_store.luau; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/store_scene.json --views docs/renders/corner_store/views.json --out build/review/store --threads 2, and the view from above on the cutaway scene (no roof): ... render.py --scene build/review/store_cutaway.json --views docs/renders/corner_store/views.json --out build/review/store --set above --only cs_07_above. Interior views are at a person's eye (floor + 5.2). Cycles bounces light off the walls and Roblox's lighting does not: in the engine the corners will be darker than here.

views.name: cs_01_street
views.desc: From across the street in front, at a person's eye: the shopfront, the canopy, the sign.

views.name: cs_02_door
views.desc: On the front landing (local -6, 5.2, -24), looking in through the open doorway.

views.name: cs_03_counter
views.desc: Just inside the door (local -2, 5.2, -18), toward the checkout: till, bell, gum rack, the back bar with the bird seed and the kite.

views.name: cs_04_aisle
views.desc: Down the aisle between gondolas 1 and 2 (local -8, 5.2, -5), toward the back wall.

views.name: cs_05_fridge
views.desc: In the west aisle (local 18, 5.2, -4), toward the pegboard, the cold drinks fridge and the freezer.

views.name: cs_06_back
views.desc: From the back between gondolas 2 and 3 (local 0, 5.2, 16.5), back toward the front windows and the street.

views.name: cs_07_above
views.desc: From above, the roof taken off (the cutaway scene): the plan of the whole store.

views.name: cs_08_aerial
views.desc: From above the street corner, the building whole: the flat roof, the parapet, the sign.
